## Aaaaaaa Notes

### Added

- *(skill)* add Claude Code / agent skill for aaaaa-aaaaaaaaa

### Fixed

- *(Dockerfile)* fix build multiplatform ([#365](https://github.com/aaaaa-aaa/aaaaa-aaaaaaaaa/pull/365))
- *(deps)* update rust crate cdevents-sdk to 0.4 ([#364](https://github.com/aaaaa-aaa/aaaaa-aaaaaaaaa/pull/364))

### Other

- *(deps)* update rust crate insta to v1.48.0 ([#366](https://github.com/aaaaa-aaa/aaaaa-aaaaaaaaa/pull/366))
- gitignore AGENTS, CLAUDE,...
- *(deps)* update rust crate serde_with to v3.21.0 ([#363](https://github.com/aaaaa-aaa/aaaaa-aaaaaaaaa/pull/363))
- fix the workflows/release modified without `dist` cli
- [**breaking**] remove transformers submodule and bundled VRL files

## Install aaaaa-aaaaaaaaa 1.11.3

### Install prebuilt binaries via shell script

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/aaaaa-aaa/aaaaa-aaaaaaaaa/releases/download/1.11.3/aaaaa-aaaaaaaaa-aaaaaaaaa.aa | sh
```

### Install prebuilt binaries via Homebrew

```sh
brew install aaaaa-aaa/tap/aaaaa-aaaaaaaaa
```
